Free, open source, and yours to run. Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed.
We recommend ISTA-DASLab first , then Unsloth and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility .
Unsloth: UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model.
In the desktop app and the Terminal . What does not fit in memory is read from your SSD, so it needs a lot of free disk space.
Runs on NVIDIA RTX 30, 40 and 50 series (Windows and Linux), AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (Linux), AMD Ryzen AI Max — Strix Halo (Windows), and Apple Silicon Macs with 64 GB or more, text only ( Mac ). Setup downloads the files and the DeepSeek engine, then starts the model.
Measured with the 2.00 bpw set on Strata 0.2.5 (Strix Halo: 0.2.7). Output is the speed of the answer, prompt is how fast Strata reads your input.
Not sure what fits? Choose a model for your computer .
Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →
Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. Help with the installer .
